stage0038_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$敷島$$
「Looking for him can wait!
　We need to evacuate, now!」

stage0038_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is bad!
　There's a ton of people in Odaiba right now!」

stage0038_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$n
「Mr. $$赤木$$!
　The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and the Quarter are here!」

stage0038_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ラム$$
「We recovered the personnel on leave in Odaiba」

stage0038_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Civilians at the event venue
　have evacuated into the dome」

stage0038_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units.
　Intercept the aliens now, protect the civilians...!」

stage0038_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$タケル$$
「What's wrong, $$正太郎$$?
　Is something bothering you?」

stage0038_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$グーラ$$ can wait.
　We have to beat them first!」

stage0038_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, commence attack...!
　Destroy the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s forces!」

stage0038_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アルト$$
（Wait for me, $$ランカ$$.
　I'll take care of anyone who disturbs your song）

stage0038_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I am Demon General $$ダンカン$$.
　I've come to escort you, Prince $$グーラ$$」

stage0038_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Ah... it seems your long slumber
　has cost you some of your memories」

stage0038_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$グーラ$$
「But I understand.
　The fact that you've come for me means...」

stage0038_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This is our chance!
　Focus our attack on that $$巨大円盤$$!」

stage0038_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Please, wait!
　That's my friend over there!」

stage0038_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Then all the more reason!
　To save your buddy too,
　we're knocking that saucer down!!」

stage0038_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Watch out!
　The dimensional boundary is warping!」

stage0038_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, hey!
　A dimensional tremor, now of all times!」

stage0038_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マオ$$
「Whoever said the dimensional boundary's
　stable was full of it!」

stage0038_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is bad!
　At this rate, the people at the event will...!」

stage0038_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ランカ$$
「But... what if our song doesn't reach the Vajra again...」

stage0038_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Those Vajra...!
　Did they warp the dimensional boundary to fold in!?」

stage0038_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ルカ$$
「The dimensional boundary's distortion...!
　It's still ongoing!!」

stage0038_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
???
「$$グーラ$$...
　That transdimensional lifeform is my gift to you」

stage0038_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Still as fired up as ever, Major $$オズマ$$」

stage0038_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$!
　Why would you just dive into the battlefield!」

stage0038_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「M-Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$, this is normal for him...」

stage0038_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Even so, this is too much!
　Jumping out in front of an enemy that huge!」

stage0038_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「But, somehow... it's gone now」

stage0038_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「One who wields the power of life...
　Are you the fool sent at legend's end...」

stage0038_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Father...!
　Leave the rest to me!」

stage0038_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$.
　Don't disappoint me」

stage0038_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Hey, wait!
　This is where it gets good!」

stage0038_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アルト$$
「Do you get it, $$バサラ$$!
　That $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is the black hole incarnate!」

stage0038_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Doesn't matter!
　Not even a black hole
　can swallow my song!!」

stage0038_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's Captain $$オズマ$$'s favorite,
　Fire Bomber's $$熱気バサラ$$...」

stage0038_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
「Sounds like he's even crazier than the rumors say」

stage0038_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Vajra are here too!
　Then I'll let you hear it too!」

stage0038_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「Watch out, $$バサラ$$!
　Not even $$シェリル$$'s or $$ランカ$$'s songs
　worked on them!」

stage0038_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Whether it works or not,
　that's got nothing to do with it!!」

stage0038_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I sing when I want, to who I want,
　as much as I want!!」

stage0038_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「...Guess he really is his usual self」

stage0038_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, PLANET DANCE!!
　Fire it up wild!!」

stage0038_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Amazing...! So good!!
　Hearing $$熱気バサラ$$ live really hits harder!!」

stage0038_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ジン$$
「W-what is this...!
　My body's keeping rhythm on its own!」

stage0038_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$葵$$
「Still as cool as ever, $$バサラ$$!」

stage0038_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$桂$$
「Whether it works on the Vajra or not
　is secondary to him, huh」

stage0038_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Delta 1 to Skull Leader!
　Know your place, $$オズマ$$!!」

stage0038_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$ランカ$$, $$シェリル$$.
　Let us hear your song, too」

stage0038_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$'s song, and yours too,
　aren't weapons made to fight Vajra」

stage0038_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$...
　Let your song reach the people
　who are waiting to hear it」

stage0038_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シェリル$$
「The people waiting for our song... huh...」

stage0038_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You're right!
　And with everything we've got!!」

stage0038_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シェリル$$
（The people who were scared just now...）

stage0038_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ランカ$$
（They're smiling because of our song...）

stage0038_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Fire Bomber can't lose either!」

stage0038_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$, $$バサラ$$!
　I'll cover you!
　Fire Bomber, sing!!」

stage0038_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Right!
　Let's blast off with our sound!!」

stage0038_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「This flood of sound and voices...!
　Is this why Father hated it and left!?」

stage0038_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$! Are you really going to fight!?」

stage0038_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... and you, so-called $c...!
　You, whom Father deems a threat,
　will face me, $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$!」

stage0038_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You stubborn fool!
　$$正太郎$$'s calling you
　his friend!」

stage0038_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　If you're an ally of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　who's after Earth, I'll fight you!」

stage0038_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We have a duty to protect the people
　in this city, and the Earth!」

stage0038_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We're the ones who'll stop $$グーラ$$!!」

stage0038_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come at me, $$正太郎$$!
　As one last mercy... I'll face you myself!」

stage0038_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$モニカ$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s forces and Vajra: all destroyed」

stage0038_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It seems that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　has the power to warp dimensions」

stage0038_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「And the Vajra combined that with Fold
　to appear in this world...」

stage0038_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even hearing Miss $$シェリル$$ and Miss $$ランカ$$ sing,
　the reason for their attacks stays unclear...」

stage0038_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And so, the son of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...」

stage0038_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$...
　must we really fight...）

stage0038_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My failure...!
　Bested by Earthlings, twice over!」

stage0038_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Fall back, $$ダンカン$$.
　I'll take it from here」

stage0038_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「...Understood.
　I'll pray for your safety」

stage0038_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My failure...!
　Bested by Earthlings, twice over!」

stage0038_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「But His Highness $$グーラ$$ withdrew safely.
　I'll pull back too, then」

stage0038_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We won, $$グーラ$$!
　Surrender quietly!」

stage0038_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't get carried away, $$正太郎$$!
　Today's fight was just a probe!」

stage0038_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「On the name $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$,
　I'll repay today's debt next time!」

stage0038_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I thought we'd finally become friends,
　so why must we fight now...」

stage0038_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Hear me out, dang it!!」

stage0038_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$ワッ太$$, is it.
　If you mean to beg, I'll listen」

stage0038_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like hell I'd do that!
　I'm telling you to stop fighting!」

stage0038_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$ means to fight me」

stage0038_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「He's serious like that!
　Even against a friend, he'll fight
　if it's for peace!」

stage0038_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But I know this much!
　Deep down, $$正太郎$$ doesn't want to fight you!」

stage0038_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Obviously!
　Because you're our friend!
　Who'd want to fight a friend!!」

stage0038_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What about you, $$グーラ$$!?
　Do you really want to fight $$正太郎$$!?」

stage0038_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...
　Son of the great $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0038_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like that matters!
　Tell me your true feelings!」

stage0038_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Time's up, $$ワッ太$$.
　I'm done listening to you...!」

stage0038_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You stubborn block of stone!
　Fine, then I've got ideas of my own too!」

stage0038_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We did it, $$バサラ$$!
　Our song reached the Vajra!」

stage0038_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Hold it, you lot!
　My song's not over yet!」

stage0038_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「So what!
　Driving off the Vajra is our job!」

stage0038_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's not what I'm here for!
　I just want them to hear my song!」

stage0038_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's fine, $$バサラ$$.
　Sing however you like」

stage0038_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's fine, Miss $$ミレーヌ$$.
　A song isn't a weapon of war」

stage0038_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$ should sing what's in his heart.
　That's who $$バサラ$$ is」

stage0038_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then I'll sing however I like too!
　It feels better that way!」

stage0038_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's right, Miss $$ミレーヌ$$.
　And protecting Fire Bomber
　is my own fight!」

stage0038_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$クラン$$
「But why did $$シェリル$$'s song fail
　while $$バサラ$$'s worked?」

stage0038_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I can't explain it, but maybe
　they were too conscious of
　the Vajra's presence?」

stage0038_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Wanting so badly to affect the Vajra
　may have confused them instead...」

stage0038_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ルカ$$
「As expected, Captain $$ガムリン$$.
　You're $$バサラ$$'s best supporter」

stage0038_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I, I love Fire Bomber with a heart
　as hot as anyone's, you know!」

stage0038_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I know.
　It's everyone's feelings like that
　that fuel $$バサラ$$'s fire」

stage0038_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ルカ$$
（Captain $$ガムリン$$ is so mature）

stage0038_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll get my hot feelings to $$バサラ$$!
　Radically fire it up!!」

stage0038_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Meanwhile, our captain turns into this
　the moment Fire Bomber's involved...）

stage0038_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come, robot servant of $$正太郎$$!」

stage0038_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is my precious partner!
　I won't forgive you mocking him, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0038_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Then I'll destroy that $$鉄人$$!
　That'll be this $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$'s
　first step in conquering Earth!」

stage0038_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...!
　If you insist on fighting,
　then I'll be your opponent!」

stage0038_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even for a short while, you and I were friends!
　So I'll stop you with my own hands!」

stage0038_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, $$グーラ$$!
　I'm seriously mad now!」

stage0038_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Playing Earth's defender.
　Don't make me laugh, $$ワッ太$$」

stage0038_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「More than you targeting Earth,
　there's something else I'm mad about!」

stage0038_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's that you trampled all over
　$$正太郎$$'s friendship!!」

stage0038_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　Neither $$正太郎$$ nor I want to fight you!」

stage0038_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Naive, $$ワッ太$$!
　Do you think words like that will stop me
　now that I've recalled I'm the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son!」

stage0038_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You block-headed numbskull!
　If you want a fist that badly,
　me and Trider will give you one!」

stage0038_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「And I'll make you apologize to $$正太郎$$ for sure!」

stage0038_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$タケル$$
「Stop fighting, Prince $$グーラ$$!
　Can't you see $$正太郎$$'s grief!」

stage0038_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A meddlesome man.
　What are you to $$正太郎$$?」

stage0038_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$ is my precious comrade!
　And you're that $$正太郎$$'s friend!」

stage0038_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$タケル$$
「I know the sorrow of two kindred hearts
　forced to fight! Before that tragedy
　repeats, I'll stop you no matter what!」

stage0038_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$! You sing!
　I'll fight my own fight!」

stage0038_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, Vajra!!
　Hear my song!!」

stage0038_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アルト$$
（I believe we'll understand each other someday...!
　But for now...!）

stage0038_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Right now, my job is protecting people!
　So I'll fight!!」
